instruction: Adjust Thunderbird to automatically create emails in plain text format rather than HTML.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the email composer to use plain text format instead of HTML. The evaluator checks the mail.identity.id1.compose_html preference in prefs.js to verify it is set to false (plain text mode). Uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: configuring Thunderbird to compose in plain text by default
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly retrieves the Thunderbird preferences file from VM filesystem
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses prefs.js and checks the exact preference key 'mail.identity.id1.compose_html' for value 'false'
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird window to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before verification
Data flow is semantically correct: VM file retrieval → local cache → preference parsing → value comparison
Edge cases handled: get_vm_file returns None on failure, metric returns 0.0 for None input
Expected value is semantically correct: 'mail.identity.id1.compose_html = false' is the correct Thunderbird preference for plain text composition
Static validator type warning is not a semantic issue: get_vm_file returns str when multi=False (default), and metric handles None gracefully

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
